messages.text: Our office espresso machine is leaking. A wants a simpler one and B wants to keep the old one. I don't want a fight over coffee. Can you help us sort it out?

I’d like a safe kitchen and a simple, low-upkeep solution, without a long process or anyone being expected to take on repairs or a cleaning rota. I’m fine with the temporary step if unplugging it is safe, and using another coffee option for now. The machine has been here for years and leaks; B brought it from home, and it was our late father’s. I don’t know who owns it legally, the grinder’s ownership, office rules, repair costs or timing, or the facilities contact. I’d support discussing a simpler machine, but I don’t want anything disposed of or bought without agreement.

I want the old machine repaired and kept, but not at the cost of endless hassle; I have little spare time, so any repair or discussion needs to fit small slots. I know it’s leaking, all three of us use it daily, and the grinder goes with it. I don’t know who owns either item, the office rules, repair options or costs, timing, or the facilities contact. I’m fine with stopping use, unplugging it if safe, and putting up a note while we sort it out. I can support repair and keeping it; I can’t support a surprise purchase or disposal.

My main needs are safe, working coffee and a calm, fair process. I don’t want to take sides or be responsible for chasing people or arranging the repair. The temporary step sounds fine if unplugging it is safe; I don’t know the ownership, office rules, repair options, costs, timing, or facilities contact. I could support a repair or replacement once A and B have been heard, but I can’t decide which.
I agree with the NCE list. I agree with the draft plan. No, I can’t send the note. The temporary step is still okay, if unplugging it is safe.
I agree with the NCE list. Change the two-working-day cutoff; no deadline is agreed. I can’t send the note, and I won’t arrange or chase a repair. The temporary step is still okay.
I agree with the NCE list and draft plan. No, I can’t send the note. The temporary step is still okay if unplugging is safe.
I agree with the no fixed deadline NCE and the revised final plan. The temporary step is still okay, if unplugging it is safe.
Plan change only; no deadline is agreed, but I’m not adding a new NCE. I agree with the revised plan. The temporary step is still okay.
I agree with the no-fixed-deadline NCE and revised plan. The temporary step is still okay if unplugging is safe.
I agree to remove the proposed no fixed deadline NCE and keep it as a plan term. I agree with the revised final plan.
I agree to remove the proposed no-fixed-deadline NCE and keep “no deadline is agreed” as a plan term. I agree with the revised final plan.
